text:
aisha: Heads-up — post-merge smoke on main shows a late-tail memory uptick for longseq. I opened a PR to add sampled heap profiles and an upload for canary runs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8399 Can folks take eyes? I attached a short bench + pprof artifacts.

max: Looking now. Which canary/job should I inspect? link?

aisha: The failing run is `ci/longseq-canary/20260317-22` — artifacts at https://ci.redwood/bench/20260317-22/files and perf bundle at artifacts://bench/5123456789/sampled-tail.tar.gz

joni: I noticed a similar late tail spike yesterday on canary-849, might be related to KV shard retention changes from last week.

perf-bot: New benchmark uploaded: artifacts://bench/5123456789/sampled-tail.tar.gz (contains p95/p99 histograms, heapdiff.txt, flame graphs)

aisha: Summary: p95 roughly steady, p99 ~ +30% vs baseline, memory p95 +12%. Heapdiff shows retained set growing during prefill -> spike around token ~3800.

max: Quick suggestion — include the raw pprof flame for heap: run `python tools/collect_pprof.py --job 20260317-22 --out /tmp/pprof` and upload. I can triage once I have the flame.

joni: grabbing heapdiffs now. Also can you add a tiny reproducer: `./bazel run //runtime/tools:longseq --tokens=4k --model=redwood/4k` this makes debugging easier.

aisha: done — uploaded heapdiff + flame: https://artifacts.internal/bench/5123456789/heapdiff.txt and https://artifacts.internal/bench/5123456789/flame.html

max: I see large retention rooted at `KVShard::shard_entries` and `CachedPrefix::entry`. Recent commit abc123 widened the eviction window — that could explain longer-lived entries.

joni: If that's the culprit a small guard to prevent retaining beyond shard size should fix it. I can do a quick review of the call path.

aisha: Operational note: this merged to main at 22:15 UTC. If we want an immediate rollback, it would hit our next maintenance window at 02:00. Hotfix would be preferable if it's small.

max: I'll open a follow-up with a guard+test. Will ping for 2 reviewers. (@joni @aisha)

max: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8402 — tiny guard in KV eviction + unit test.

joni: Reviewing now — adding a couple inline comments about corner cases but overall looks good. Also strongly +1 on adding a nightly synthetic longseq bench to CI to catch regressions earlier.

aisha: For immediate mitigation, propose policy: if canary p99 > baseline * 1.2, auto-roll back. Can someone wire that as a threshold? Also schedule the synthetic bench discussion in next sprint.

perf-bot: Canary alert rule created: `canary.memory.p99 > baseline * 1.2` — alerting to #eng-runtime-canary

joni: LGTM on the PR after addressing my nit. We should merge and retrigger the canary.

max: Merged PR #8402, retriggering the failing canary: `ci rerun 20260317-22-longseq-canary` — monitoring.

perf-bot: Canary run complete: p99 back within baseline. Memory p95 stable. Closing the incident ticket.

aisha: Thanks all. Follow-ups: (1) add synthetic 4k tokens nightly bench, (2) add small unit to assert shard retention bounds, (3) add canary threshold to docs. I'll create tickets.

max: I'll open the ticket for synthetic bench and add the test to the PR backlog.

joni: Thanks — happy to help with infra for the nightly bench.

perf-bot: Thread closed (auto-archive after 72h of inactivity).
